turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We want to keep our weekly game night but now there's a toddler in the house. Tiny pieces everywhere.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a real worry, small pieces are a choking risk. Play after bedtime when you can, and do a quick count of the pieces when you pack up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He doesn't go to bed till eight.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then before eight, pick games with bigger parts, like card games or tile games with chunky tiles.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He grabs cards too. And chews them.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Give him his own set of big, safe pieces to play with next to you. Toddlers love feeling included.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He'd love having his own game.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: And a tray with a lip under the board helps. Things don't roll off the table, and you can lift the whole game out of reach.
